title: Used to / Would / Be Used to — Upper-Intermediate

questions.def: "Used to" describes a past habit or state.
questions.question: I ___ smoke, but I quit last year.

questions.def: "Get used to" means to become accustomed to.
questions.question: She ___ the early mornings after a week.

questions.def: "Used to live" indicates a past, discontinued residence.
questions.question: They ___ in London before moving to Spain.

questions.def: "Would" describes a past habit, often negative.
questions.question: He ___ always complain about the weather.

questions.def: "Be used to" means to be accustomed to something.
questions.question: I ___ drinking coffee in the evenings.

questions.def: "Got used to" means became accustomed to.
questions.question: He ___ to the noise after a while.

questions.def: "Used to" describes a past habitual action.
questions.question: We ___ go to that restaurant every Friday.

questions.def: "Would" can express a repeated action in the past.
questions.question: They ___ visit their grandparents every summer.

questions.def: "Used to live" indicates a past, discontinued residence.
questions.question: He ___ in a small village.

questions.def: "Is getting used to" describes becoming accustomed.
questions.question: She ___ the city life, coming from a rural area.

questions.def: "Used to" expresses a past habit or state.
questions.question: He ___ help his father in the shop.

questions.def: "Used to work" indicates a past, discontinued action.
questions.question: They ___ long hours at the factory.

questions.def: "Used to" (after 'am') means accustomed to.
questions.question: I'm ___ the noise; I don't even notice it anymore.

questions.def: "Used to" signifies a past habit.
questions.question: She ___ to play the piano every day.

questions.def: "Used to travel" indicates a past, discontinued action.
questions.question: He ___ a lot for business.

questions.def: "Used to" describes a past habit.
questions.question: We ___ go swimming in the lake, but it's polluted now.

questions.def: "Would" can express a repeated past action.
questions.question: I ___ walk to school when I was younger.

questions.def: "Used to drink" indicates a past habit.
questions.question: I ___ coffee every morning.

questions.def: "Used to" describes a past state.
questions.question: He ___ be shy, but now he's very outgoing.

questions.def: "Is getting used to" means becoming accustomed.
questions.question: She ___ the taste of the new medicine.

questions.def: "Used to live" indicates a past, discontinued residence.
questions.question: I ___ near the park.

questions.def: "Used to" describes a past belief.
questions.question: People ___ think the Earth was flat.

questions.def: "Would" expresses a repeated action in the past.
questions.question: He ___ tell me stories about his childhood.

questions.def: 'Didn't use to' describes a past habit that is no longer true.
questions.question: I ___ drink coffee, but now I love it.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses a repeated action in the past.
questions.question: When we were kids, my grandpa ___ tell us stories.

questions.def: It should be 'used', not 'use', when talking about being accustomed to something.
questions.question: She is use to working late, so it doesn't bother her.

questions.def: 'Used to live' refers to a past state that is no longer true.
questions.question: He ___ in London before moving to Rome.

questions.def: 'Got used to' describes the process of becoming accustomed to something.
questions.question: After a week, I ___ the noisy city centre.

questions.def: 'Used to' describes a past state or habit that is no longer true.
questions.question: My sister ___ hate vegetables, but now she loves them.

questions.def: It should be 'used', not 'using' + need a 'to' after used.
questions.question: I am using to wake up early every day now.
